ev.q: CDC analyzed data from the Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System
Chi-square tests were used to test for significant differences (p<0.05) in the proportion of women reporting PDS
overall prevalence of self-reported PDS ranged from 11.7% (Maine) to 20.4% (New Mexico)
the median difference across all states in the proportion of women reporting PDS between two levels of each covariate was calculated
collects self-reported information on maternal attitudes and experiences
PRAMS is an ongoing, state-specific, population-based surveillance project
